text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I arrive at work in the morning
ready to start the day, Tazuna
Hayakawa, the director's
secretary,
approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. It's finally time
to start
working with your trainee, isn't
it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Together, you'll strengthen your bodies
and minds as you forge an inseparable
bond. I'm
certain you'll have the most
fruitful time together!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you're able to achieve consistent
results, you
may even earn a G1 title,
the very pinnacle of
racing!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Keep in mind that a runner's first three
years in
the Twinkle Series are the most
crucial.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If your trainee hasn't achieved a
satisfactory
record three years after her
debut...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid her contract with you may be
canceled.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That makes these three years a critical
period for
her! Please work together and
find a way to make
it through.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First things first, you should probably
start
training for the upcoming Make
Debut.
